decisionOrderEvaluated.option: Strictly constrained canonical tina-ai Preview-host validation (code)
decisionOrderEvaluated.why: The narrowest SELF-CONTAINED, deployable, and testable path given no config access. Implemented in security/cors-policy.js, gated to the staging runtime, https-only, owner-team-anchored, fail-closed for everything else.
Not needed; the priority-3 constrained validation expresses the policy safely.

whyNarrowerAndSaferThanAlternatives: Does NOT authorize arbitrary *.vercel.app: anchored to the owner's globally-unique Vercel team suffix + 'tina-' project prefix + https + exact ($) hostname anchors.
Does NOT weaken production: gated to the staging runtime via server-injected Render markers; production keeps its exact env allowlist behavior unchanged (verified live).
Does NOT introduce wildcard-with-credentials or arbitrary Origin reflection: reflects only the specific pattern-validated origin.
Fails closed for unknown, malformed, http, wrong-team, and non-vercel origins (verified live).
Does NOT embed the private ephemeral Preview hostname in a public artifact: only the stable, public project+team policy shape.
residualBreadth: The code branch is team-SCOPED (authorizes owner-team tina-* previews, incl. the sibling 'tina' project). The priority-1 exact-origin config is narrower and is the recommended tightening.
